name: Transforming First Time Experiences
source:
Mell is a lonely raccoon spending Valentine's Weekend by himself, wondering if he'll ever find someone to love, or if he'll end up being alone forever, regretting not asking someone out, like a bird he happened to pass by. Sitting on the balcony of his special place, he makes a selfish request to understand what true love feels like.

And the universe decided to answer in the strangest way possible. With an alien abduction.

[From [url=https://hollow-soul-stories.itch.io/tfte]itch.io[/url]]
